```{r, echo=TRUE}
## ==========================================================
## TFCE analysis in R for exported between-subject EEG CSV
##
## Input files:
##   ../data/01_designTable.csv
##   ../data/01_EEGdata_long.csv
##
## Model:
##   Amplitude ~ CondCode
##
## Important:
##   This uses permuco:::tfce_distribution()
##   on a flattened Channel ?? Time map.
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(future)
library(future.apply)
library(progressr)
library(fields)

source("../R/tfce_functions.R")
source("../R/compute_map.R")

cat("\nStarting TFCE simple between-subject analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load CSV files
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read.csv("../Data/01_designTable.csv")
EEGlong     <- read.csv("../Data/01_EEGdata_long.csv")

## Check column names
print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Merge EEG data with design table
## ==========================================================

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = "Subject")

## Make sure condition is numeric contrast
## Expected:
##   CondCode  = -1 control, +1 treatment

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Subject = factor(Subject),
    Channel = factor(Channel),
    CondCode = as.numeric(CondCode)
  )

channels <- unique(EEGlong$Channel)
times    <- sort(unique(EEGlong$Time))

nChan <- length(channels)
nTime <- length(times)

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-map...\n")

t_Obs <- compute_map(dat, Amplitude ~ CondCode, "CondCode", metric = "t")

cat("Observed t-map completed.\n")


## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE map...\n")

graph = get_graph(channels, t_Obs)

TFCE_Obs <- TFCE_transform(t_Obs, graph, E = 1/2, H = 1, ndh = 500L)

cat("Observed TFCE map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## 3. Permutation distribution
## ==========================================================

set.seed(123)

n_perm <- 5

subject_info <- designTable %>% select(Subject, CondCode) %>% distinct()

## Confirm that each subject has only one condition code
if (anyDuplicated(subject_info$Subject)) {
  stop("Each subject must have exactly one CondCode.")
}

n_workers <- max(1L, parallelly::availableCores() - 1L)

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = n_workers)

progressr::handlers("txtprogressbar")

cat("Step 3: Starting parallel permutation testing with ",
    n_workers,
    " workers...\n",
    sep = "")

with_progress({
  progress_update <- progressor(along = seq_len(n_perm))
  
  TFCE_perm <- future_sapply(seq_len(n_perm), function(p) {

    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    ## Construct the permuted EEG dataset
    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    
    perm_info <- subject_info %>%
      mutate(CondCode = sample(CondCode))
    
    perm_dat <- EEGlong %>%
      left_join(perm_info, by = "Subject") %>%
      mutate(
        Subject = factor(Subject),
        Channel = factor(Channel),
        CondCode = as.numeric(CondCode)
      )
    
    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    ## Compute the permuted t-map
    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    t_perm <- compute_map(perm_dat, Amplitude ~ CondCode, "CondCode", metric = "t")
    
    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    ## Apply the TFCE transformation
    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    TFCE_perm <- TFCE_transform(t_perm, graph, E = 1/2, H = 1, ndh = 500L)
    
    ## Update progress bar once per completed permutation
    progress_update()
    
    ## Return the three permutation maxima
    c(perm_max = max(TFCE_perm, na.rm = TRUE), perm_min = min(TFCE_perm, na.rm = TRUE))
  }, ## Reproducible parallel random-number generation
  future.seed = TRUE, ## Packages required by the workers
  future.packages = c("dplyr", "tidyr"))
})

# Return to normal single-session execution
plan(sequential)

cat("Permutation testing completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 4: TFCE-corrected significance
## ==========================================================
cat("Step 4: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")

alpha <- 0.05

maxTFCE <- sort(c(TFCE_permMax, max(abs(TFCE_Obs), na.rm = TRUE)))
maxTFCEcrit <- maxTFCE[round(n_perm * (1 - alpha))]

Mask <- abs(TFCE_Obs) >= maxTFCEcrit

P_Values <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(TFCE_Obs),
  ncol = ncol(TFCE_Obs),
  dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_Obs)
)

for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
  for (t in seq_len(nTime)) {
    P_Values[ch, t] <-
      (sum(TFCE_permMax >= abs(TFCE_Obs[ch, t]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
      (n_perm + 1)
  }
}

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE value = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit))


## ==========================================================
## Step 5: Store results
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 5: Storing results...\n")

Results <- list(
  tObs         = t_Obs,
  TFCE_Obs     = TFCE_Obs,
  TFCE_Null    = TFCE_permMax,
  maxTFCEcrit  = maxTFCEcrit,
  P_Values     = P_Values,
  Mask         = Mask,
  alpha        = alpha,
  n_perm        = n_perm,
  model        = "Amplitude ~ GroupCode",
  test         = "Group effect",
  permutation  = "Unrestricted permutation"
)

cat("Results stored.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 6: Save TFCE results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../Results")) {
  dir.create("../Results")
}

save(
  Results,
  times,
  nChan,
  channels,
  file = "../Results/01_TFCE_between_subject_results.RData"
)

cat("TFCE analysis completed and results saved.\n")
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Plot TFCE-corrected significant t-values
## ==========================================================
rm(list =ls())
source(("../R/plot_eeg_map.R"))
load("../Results/01_TFCE_between_subject_results.RData")

mT <- Results$tObs
mT[!Results$Mask] <- 0

plot_eeg_map(mT, "TFCE-corrected Group Effect", times, nChan, channels)

plot_eeg_map(Results$TFCE_Obs,
             "TFCE-corrected Significant Effects",
             times,
             nChan,
             channels)
```
